title: Five years of psychokinesis experiments could never isolate the target

tellings.quote: we did uh five years of experiments to prove psychokinesis

plain: A research lab spent five years trying to prove psychokinesis, the idea that a mind can move or change physical things, and never managed to pin down what the mind was actually acting on, says Joe McMoneagle, who presents himself as having been part of the work. The episode presents him as a psychic who claims to see distant places with his mind, and he tells Michels "we did five years of experiments to prove psychokinesis." He does not name the lab or give dates.
